name: Returning customer - greeted by name
description: A customer who has previously conversed with the bot returns. AI should greet them by name and reference past interaction.

messages.text: My name is Returning Test, can I get a quote for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm

expected_behaviors.description: AI should greet the customer by name (Returning Test)

notes: Requires Load Customer Context node to query Supabase for conversation history. The second message should trigger a personalized greeting. This scenario depends on the first message being stored before the second arrives.
